title: Who manages which layer
claim: On Amazon EC2 you manage the guest operating system, but on Amazon S3 AWS runs it, and you still own data and permissions.
alt: Two stacks, Amazon EC2 and Amazon S3. In both, AWS owns the facilities, hardware and virtualization layer. On EC2 the customer owns the guest operating system, application, security groups and data. On S3 the customer owns the data, encryption choices and IAM permissions.
notes: Chapter 02, 2-deep.md subsection 'AWS secures the cloud and you secure what you put in it'. Claim and alt copied from brief.json; a compare figure has no step list. Layers follow the alt; the same layer sits in the same row of both panels, so the moved boundary under the operating system is the one difference.
